newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos out of hospital by Christmas - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Ramos out of hospital by Christmas - doctor.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos is recovering well after an operation on Monday to remove an arterial block and could check out of hospital by Christmas, doctors said.
"We hope he is out by Christmas," said Raul Fores, the director of the Makati Medical Centre where Ramos underwent surgery. "He's concious right now."
He said a build-up of cholestrol had blocked an artery near the neck and that an operation was required to clear the passage. Fores refused to give more details.
"He's the athletic type," Vice-President Joseph Estrada told reporters at the presidential palace, adding that Ramos should recover swiftly.
"The best Christmas gift that our country and people can receive is the full recovery of the president," he said.
Estrada is first in line of succession if the president is incapacitated. But he told reporters: "Let us not talk about that. We are lucky ... that the operation was very successful."
